# FG-REVIEW-0026

| 項目 | 値 |
|---|---|
| HTTP ステータス | 409 |
| 重大度 | info |
| Runbook | なし |
| 発生させるテスト | `each_stop_class_stops_auto_merge` |

## 利用者向けメッセージ

- ja: この MR は自動マージを止めました（プログラムの破壊・DB の破壊・機密の流出・開発者の PC で動くコードの変更のおそれ）。MR に出ている理由を読み、直すか人がマージしてください。
- en: Auto-merge stopped for this merge request (it may break the program, destroy database data, leak a secret or change code that runs on developers' PCs). Read the reason on the merge request, then fix it or have a person merge it.
- id: Merge otomatis dihentikan untuk merge request ini (berpotensi merusak program, menghapus data basis data, membocorkan rahasia, atau mengubah kode yang berjalan di PC pengembang). Baca alasannya pada merge request, lalu perbaiki atau minta seseorang menggabungkannya.

## 原因 (cause)

M4 C9 (plan 04 M-5 / M-6, ADR-0017 Amendment 2026-11-13): the auto-merge worker of a project whose `merge.auto` is `full` (or `conditional`) found a merge request it would have added to the merge queue, but one of the stop classes holds on its head: `program_breakage` (a required check or the merge request's own `ci/pipeline` on its merge result concluded red — `required_check_failed` / `pipeline_failed` —, the merge queue's train of the merge request alone was red — `merge_queue_checks_failed` —, or `forge/risk` found a mass deletion or a change too large to assess), `data_loss` (`forge/risk`: an applied migration changed, a destructive statement, a data lifecycle job, a rollback step), `leak` (`forge/risk`: a secret by name or content), `developer_pc` (`forge/risk`: `agent_config` / `submodule_change`), or `not_assessed` (`forge/risk` ended `error` / `action_required`, or concluded `failure` without a rule forge knows: the head cannot be shown safe). A `warn` never stops. The stop is recorded on the merge request (`forge.auto_merge_states`, state `stopped`) and shown in one line; nothing was queued. Not a server fault.

## 調べ方 (diagnosis)

`forge serve` logs `forge.auto_merge.stopped` (info) once per new stop with `error_code`, `request_id`, `project_id`, `merge_request_id`, `head_sha`, `class`, `reason` and `detail` (the forge/risk rule or the check name). `GET /api/v1/projects/{id}/merge-requests/{iid}/auto-merge` answers the same state; `gstn checks list --project <id> --sha <head>` shows the forge/risk findings. Read (read-only): SELECT * FROM forge.auto_merge_states WHERE merge_request_id = <id>.

## 対処 (fix)

Nothing on the server. Fix the change (a new head is assessed again; a red check goes green by a fix or a re-run), or have a person press 'merge when ready' after reading the reason: a person's merge is not stopped by auto-merge. The forge/risk rules cannot be lowered by a project.
